units.function: Express/Supertest contract suite for company portability preview/export/import across board, CEO Agent and Cloud tenant actors, synchronous/async JSON/ZIP transports and process-memory job status.
units.dependencyDirection: Fake request actors and mocked application services exercise the real monolithic companies router; dynamically imported router instances isolate or share route-local job Maps for job identity/concurrency tests.
units.keyDataModels: Company/actor IDs, free-form CEO role, portability include/target/collision strategy, Cloud stack headers, inline/ZIP source, ImportJob status/full result and company.imported activity.
units.lifecycle: Authorize actor, preview/export or accept sync/async import; validate/decompress transport; start in-memory job; poll by actor-bound ID; adopt duplicate or reject different request; retain terminal result one hour then return 404.
units.testAssessment: Approved unsandboxed focused Vitest passed all 38 tests. The suite is broad and behavior-focused for route authorization ordering, cross-company denial, board-job isolation, duplicate UX, sync/async signals, multipart conversion, terminal retry and truncated ZIP rejection. Services are mocked, so persistence/transaction/resource safety is unproved. Missing cases include target-level concurrency across users, durable restart recovery, stable error codes, approval/data authority, cancellation/timeout/progress, idempotency across processes and adversarial ZIP traversal/symlink/encryption/ratio/count/Unicode/oversize inputs.
units.designRationale: Support portable Cloud/self-hosted company transfer and a UI-friendly long import path while preventing cross-company Agent access, destructive replace in Agent-safe mode and cross-user job disclosure.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs governed, durable, provenance-preserving organization import/export with consistent managed/self-hosted behavior and exact human/Agent responsibility binding.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT the contract around durable MigrationJob commands and projections. Preserve deny-before-parse tests, cross-company/actor isolation, safe collision restrictions, JSON/ZIP equivalence and duplicate-vs-different request UX. Replace per-process/per-user Maps with target-scoped durable leases and canonical request digests; require verified human authority, data contract, risk approval, Agent/run identity, stable errors and evidence/outbox records.
units.responsibilityConflict: The suite intentionally permits same-company CEO Agents to export and import. CEO Agent apply passes null as boardUserId; no human is bound to the service mutation. Any board company member may take the same actions, failures emit no activity, and successful activity is a later side effect rather than an atomic responsibility record.
evidence: 2026-08-18 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest with isolated PAPERCLIP_HOME: 38/38 passed
securityFindings: Job duplicate control is scoped to actorKey, so separate authorized users may concurrently mutate the same target company; the suite explicitly verifies other users are not blocked.

Async requests receive 202 before full payload validation and later expose raw exception messages in multiple response fields; invalid or unauthorized-at-target work can look accepted and error strings become an unstable information-bearing contract.
Board jobs retain and return the complete import result in process memory for one hour, without durable encryption, data minimization, bounded result size or restart semantics.

The sole malformed-ZIP case is truncation; archive path traversal, duplicate/case/Unicode paths, link types, encryption, entry/count/ratio/size limits and parser differential attacks remain uncovered.
A query parameter or trusted Cloud header selects async execution, but there is no idempotency key, target lease, cancellation, timeout or durable operation proof.
